test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Surat, Navsari and Bhavnagar are known for their involvement in which industry?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Diamond industry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surat**, located in the state of Gujarat, is renowned as the **diamond cutting and polishing hub of the world**. It contributes to almost **90% of the world's diamond polishing**.
 
• **Navsari**, also in Gujarat, serves as a significant center for the **diamond industry** and plays a vital role in diamond trading and processing.
 
• **Bhavnagar**, another city in Gujarat, is involved in the diamond industry and supports the overall diamond trade ecosystem in the region.
 
• The state of Gujarat has a robust **diamond manufacturing infrastructure**, which includes advanced machinery and skilled labor, making it a global leader in this sector.
 
• India's diamond industry, with Surat at its core, is a major contributor to the country's **foreign exchange earnings**. The industry exports diamonds to numerous countries, including the **United States, Hong Kong, and the United Arab Emirates**.
 
• The diamond industry also plays a significant role in generating **employment** in the region, providing jobs to millions of skilled and semi-skilled workers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Software industry**__

 __
 
• The **software industry** in India is primarily associated with cities like **Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune**, which are globally recognized as IT hubs.
 
• It contributes significantly to India's **GDP** and generates substantial **foreign exchange** through IT exports.
 
• Major IT companies like **Infosys, TCS, and Wipro** are headquartered in these cities.
 
 
 
• **Iron and steel industry**__
 __
 
• The **iron and steel industry** in India is concentrated in regions like **Bokaro, Jamshedpur, and Rourkela**.
 
• These areas are known for their proximity to **raw materials** such as iron ore and coal, essential for steel production.
 
• India is one of the largest producers of **crude steel** globally, with companies like **Tata Steel and SAIL** leading the industry.
 
 
 
• **Automobile industry**__
 
 
• The **automobile industry** in India is primarily centered in regions like **Chennai, Pune, and Gurgaon**.
 
• These areas host major automobile companies like **Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai, and Tata Motors**.
 
• India is one of the largest manufacturers of **two-wheelers and passenger vehicles** in the world.
